test_case_name: Access Help Centre from Privacy Policy page

intents.intent: Click the 'FAQs' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
And then check that the 'Ryanair Help Centre' page is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate from Help Centre to Special Assistance section

intents.intent: Click the 'FAQs' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click the 'Special Assistance' link on the 'Ryanair Help Centre' page
And then check that the 'Special Assistance' section is displayed

test_case_name: Search for information in the Help Centre after navigating from Privacy Policy

intents.intent: Click the 'FAQs' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Type $name into the input with placeholder 'I am looking for…' on the 'Ryanair Help Centre' page
Click the 'Search' button on the 'Ryanair Help Centre' page
And then check that the search results are displayed
